summary: The cache-generation guard prevents an in-flight older read from overwriting a cache primed by a committed save, and the focused race test covers the scenario.

evidence: storeProviderSelection increments the cache generation after the KV write succeeds and primes the cache with the saved selection.
loadProviderSelectionCached only writes a loaded value when the generation is unchanged, preventing a pre-save read from replacing the saved cache.
The added DeferredSelectionKv test holds an in-flight read across an admin save and verifies the saved value remains cached after that read resolves.
